example.correction: Use an authenticated GET request to a documented Fuel Finder API resource URL with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication; fetching the GOV.UK guidance page returns HTML, not fuel-price JSON.

description.correction: Fuel Finder is the permanent statutory UK scheme. Motor fuel traders report data to the central service; users can obtain a twice-daily CSV or access current JSON data through an OAuth 2.0-authenticated REST API.

notes: The cited interim retailer-feed scheme closed and its guidance was withdrawn on 1 May 2026. Fuel Finder replaced it. The old retailer links were removed; the replacement offers a twice-daily CSV and a REST API whose access requires GOV.UK One Login and OAuth 2.0 client credentials. No authoritative API quota or CORS policy was located.
